name: Facet
text: Choose a light theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It maximizes visibility for daytime use, when most users work, and keeps colors crisp against data-heavy screens. The trade-off is slightly reduced comfort in low-light rooms, but we’ll auto-switch to dark mode when ambient light drops—so users get the best of both without manual effort.

name: Pane
text: Auto-switching fails when users move between light sources—sun through a window, a lamp, another screen—causing jarring shifts that break focus. A manual toggle respects user control and avoids hidden cognitive load; settle it with a week-long A/B test measuring task completion speed and user-reported comfort.
